demo.program:
# Pascal — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Pascal?", "Niklaus Wirth"),
    ("What paradigm is Pascal?", "procedural"),
    ("What is creator?", "Niklaus Wirth"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1970"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".pas"),
    ("What is hello world?", "writeln('Hello, world!');"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
